chore: adaptations for nightly-2026-06-22 nightly#254

Please review this PR. At the next toolchain release this diff will land in 'master'.

nightly#253 is kind of a nightmare to review because it changes over 500 files. I feel like nightly#254 is now a problematic PR because now we have two nightmare PRs to review and it's not clear which one we should be working on. Should one of 253 and 254 be closed so that our efforts can be concentrated on getting one of these over the line?

Yes. Please do so freely. :-)

It's always fine to close some prefix of still-open adaptation PRs, if you're then merging the next one in the sequence. But getting to them one at a time means you have more finely separated out diffs.
